$comment: Catalogue entries this pipeline provides, to be ingested into the Agora catalogue. Run details are in each dataset's meta.json. A denominator can come from another dataset ({dataset, filter}): its yearly values divide every month of that year. A variable with "measure_of" is another measure (a share) of that variable: the web shows both as one layer.
